answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day dedicates one certified microphone to monitor whisper-level signal at a lotus pond. Validators check nonce-bound sample attestations and register each device to at most one ID/day; failure denies listing. Ten IDs need ten devices: shared hosts or parallel sampling cannot reuse a registration. Power recurs; microphones are reusable capital; no stake. This assumes honest certification of one unclonable key per device and tamper-resistant sampling. Spare devices make extra IDs cheap; it meters device access, not owners.
